integration.disposition: Consolidated exposed/persistent/revived partition, exact drift rearrangement, Gaussian jitter analysis, safe-walker counting, and revival-count refinement into main chapter proofs.
repairs: Retain favorable companion mass in the cloning probability estimate.
Use exact exposed-mass inequality instead of approximation.
Keep all alive and revived offset terms.
A reciprocal-distance barrier has infinite Gaussian expectation; establish an integrable-barrier kernel estimate and state the Taylor estimate only with its required Hessian bound.
O(1/N) revival needs O(1) expected death count; rare total extinction does not imply that count bound.
Use conditional independence for exponential all-dead bound, and retain probability of the safe-stage condition.

integration.disposition: Recovered weighted minimum-coefficient argument and explicit positive weights; supplied complete conditional-expectation composition with correct matrix order.
repairs: Preserve relative rates rather than multiplying them by Lyapunov weights.
Propagate additive constants through the kinetic stage.
Apply the diagonal result only to diagonal component bounds; general cross terms are handled in the combined convergence chapter.

integration.disposition: Consolidated six-step summary proof into direct links to the full in-chapter Keystone, variance, collision, boundary, and composition proofs.
repairs: Replace obsolete source line numbers by theorem references.
